children: Coal India Ltd. (NSE:COALINDIA) reported strong Q2 with revenue ~Rs44,179cr and profit ~Rs6,520–6,547cr as offtake and e‑auction share rose, record 310 rakes/day boosted evacuations, mixed realizations, rising EBITDA outlook and interim dividend Rs10.25/sh set for Nov 4, 2026.
Coal India Ltd. Q2 Revenue, Profit Rise; Of t ake
: Coal India (COALINDIA) Q2 revenue ~Rs44,179cr (+21% YoY), net profit ~Rs6,520–6,547cr (+53–57% YoY). Q2 coal offtake ~186.3MT (+12% YoY). Interim dividend Rs10.25/sh; H1 capex Rs7,965.7cr.
Coal India EBITDA, Of ftake Growth
: COALINDIA: EBITDA rose year‑on‑year with improving margins; offtake increased driven by FSA and e‑auction growth, e‑auction share climbed; realizations mixed across FSA, e‑auction and washed coal.
Coal India Allocates 118 Lakh via SWMA
: Coal India (COALINDIA) allocated 118 lakh tonnes via SWMA e-auctions in October 2026 from 129.24 lakh offered (91% allocation). E-auction premiums rose to 140% above notified prices.
: Coal India (COALINDIA) set a record in October 2026 with an average of 310 rakes per day for power-sector coal, the highest monthly rail evacuation average in the company’s history.
: Coal India (COALINDIA) trades near 4x Sept'28E EV/EBITDA. Analyst sees EBITDA growth rising from 4% in H1FY27 to 17% in H2FY27 and sets a INR 465 target at 5x 1HFY29E.
: Coal India (COALINDIA) set the dividend record date for Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Shareholders must be registered by that date to qualify for the dividend.
: H1FY27 Coal India (COALINDIA) capex: Rs 2,152cr on mine/evacuation infrastructure, Rs 2,033cr on land acquisition, Rs 1,394cr on plant and machinery.
: Coal India (COALINDIA): domestic coal stocks at power plants dropped from 35.13 MT end-July to 18.60 MT by Oct 1; imported coal stocks fell from 2.89 MT to 2.46 MT.
